thought.text: Saya uji Venice langsung — daftar alur, free tier, API key, dan kualitas model uncensored-nya.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && echo "=== pricing page ==="; curl -s --max-time 40 "https://venice.ai/pricing" -o /tmp/vp.html -w "[%{http_code}] "; python3 - <<'PY'
import re,html
s=open('/tmp/vp.html',errors='ignore').read()
s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); s=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',s,flags=re.S)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s)); t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t)
i=t.lower().find('free')
print(t[max(0,i-200):i+1200] if i>0 else t[:900])
PY
